name: list_branches
description: List branch names and tip commit SHAs for an Origin-hosted repository. Optional prefix filters each page after pagination.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

prefix.description: Case-sensitive branch name prefix. Applied per page after pagination; keep following nextPageToken even when a page has no matches.
